arxiv-2305-02225.title: Data Privacy with Homomorphic Encryption in Neural Networks Training and Inference Thanks: This work was partially supported by the Norte Portugal Regional Operational Programme (NORTE 2020), under the PORTUGAL 2020 Partnership Agreement, through the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF), within
arxiv-2305-02225.creator: Ivone Amorim, Eva Maia, Pedro Barbosa, Isabel Praça
arxiv-2305-02225.description: Abstract The use of Neural Networks (NNs) for sensitive data processing is becoming increasingly popular, raising concerns about data privacy and security. Homomorphic Encryption (HE) has the potential to be used as a solution to preserve data privacy in NN.

arxiv-2305-13201.title: Disappearing Without a Trace: The Arrows of Time in Kent’s Solution to the Lorentzian Quantum Reality Problem
arxiv-2305-13201.creator: Emily Adlam
arxiv-2305-13201.description: Abstract Most existing proposals to explain the temporal asymmetries we see around us are sited within an approach to physics based on time evolution, and thus they typically put the asymmetry in at the beginning of time in the form of a special initial state.

arxiv-2306-07131.title: Injection-seeded high-power Yb:YAG thin-disk laser stabilized by the Pound-Drever-Hall method Journal: oe Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2306-07131.creator: Manuel Zeyen, 1,* Lukas Affolter, 1 Marwan Abdou Ahmed, 2 Thomas Graf, 2 Oguzhan Kara, 1 Klaus Kirch, 1,3 Adrian Langenbach, 1 Miroslaw Marszalek, 1 François Nez, 4 Ahmed Ouf, 5 Randolf Pohl, 5,6 Siddharth Rajamohanan, 5 Pauline Yzombard, 4 Aldo Antognini, 1,3,* and Karsten Schuhmann 1
arxiv-2306-07131.description: Abstract Abstract: We demonstrate an injection-seeded thin-disk Yb:YAG laser at 1030 nm, stabilized by the Pound-Drever-Hall (PDH) method. We modified the PDH scheme to obtain an error signal free from Trojan locking points, which allowed robust re-locking of the laser and reliable long-term operation.

arxiv-2308-03847.title: CaloScore v2: Single-shot Calorimeter Shower Simulation with Diffusion Models
arxiv-2308-03847.creator: Vinicius Mikuni, Benjamin Nachman
arxiv-2308-03847.description: Abstract Diffusion generative models are promising alternatives for fast surrogate models, producing high-fidelity physics simulations. However, the generation time often requires an expensive denoising process with hundreds of function evaluations, restricting the current applicability of these models in a realistic setting.

arxiv-2401-08291.title: Realization of robust quantum noise characterization in the presence of coherent errors
arxiv-2401-08291.creator: P. Penshin ∗, T. Amro ∗, T. Zabelotsky, A. Abramovich, T. Pandit, K. I. O Ben ’Attar, A. Hen, R. Uzdin, N. Bar-Gill
arxiv-2401-08291.description: Abstract Complex quantum systems and their various applications are susceptible to noise of coherent and incoherent nature. Characterization of noise and its sources is an open, key challenge in quantum technology applications, especially in terms of distinguishing between inherent incoherent noise and systematic coherent errors.

arxiv-2403-11880.title: Topological edge modes and phase transition in the critical fermionic chain with long-range interaction
arxiv-2403-11880.creator: Wen-Hao Zhong, Wei-Lin Li, Yong-Chang Chen, Xue-Jia Yu
arxiv-2403-11880.description: Abstract The long-range interaction can fundamentally alter properties in gapped topological phases such as emergent massive edge modes. However, recent research has shifted attention to topological nontrivial critical points or phases, and it is natural to explore how long-range interaction influences them.

arxiv-2404-17632.title: False Vacuum Decay Rate From Thin To Thick Walls
arxiv-2404-17632.creator: Marco Matteini, Miha Nemevšek, Yutaro Shoji, Lorenzo Ubaldi
arxiv-2404-17632.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Marco Matteini, Miha Nemevšek, Yutaro Shoji, Lorenzo Ubaldi. We consider a single real scalar field in flat spacetime with a polynomial potential up to ϕ 4 \phi^{4} , that has a local minimum, the false vacuum, and a deeper global minimum, the true vacuum. When the vacua are almost degenerate we are in the thin wall regime, while as their difference in potential energy increases, we approach the thick wall regime.

arxiv-2406-04058.title: Watching Popular Musicians Learn by Ear: A Hypothesis-Generating Study of Human-Recording Interactions in YouTube Videos CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in HCI
arxiv-2406-04058.creator: Christopher Liscio, Daniel G. Brown
arxiv-2406-04058.description: Abstract . Popular musicians often learn music by ear. It is unclear what role technology plays for those with experience at this task. In search of opportunities for the development of novel human-recording interactions, we analyze 18 YouTube videos depicting real-world examples of by-ear learning, and discuss why, during this preliminary phase of research, online videos are appropriate data.

arxiv-2407-05557.title: R 2 \text{R}^{2} -Guard : Robust Reasoning Enabled LLM Guardrail via Knowledge-Enhanced Logical Reasoning WARNING: This paper includes content that may be considered offensive.
arxiv-2407-05557.creator: Mintong Kang, Bo Li
arxiv-2407-05557.description: Abstract As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly prevalent across various applications, it is critical to establish safety guardrails to moderate input/output of LLMs and ensure compliance with safety policies. Existing guardrail models, such as OpenAI Mod and LlamaGuard, treat various safety categories (e.g.

arxiv-2410-17819.title: Effects of scalar non-Gaussianity on induced scalar-tensor gravitational waves
arxiv-2410-17819.creator: Raphaël Picard, and Matthew W. Davies
arxiv-2410-17819.description: Abstract If primordial scalar or tensor perturbations are enhanced on short scales, it may lead to the production of observable gravitational wave signals. These waves may be sourced by scalar-scalar, scalar-tensor or tensor-tensor interactions. Typically, models of inflation capable of producing large peaks in the scalar primordial power spectrum also generate sizeable scalar non-Gaussianity.

arxiv-2510-04300.title: Time-resolved characterization of pulsed squeezed light from a strongly driven silicon nitride microresonator
arxiv-2510-04300.creator: Emanuele Brusaschi, Marco Liscidini, Matteo Galli, Daniele Bajoni, Massimo Borghi
arxiv-2510-04300.description: Abstract Silicon nitride microresonators driven by strong pump pulses can generate squeezed light in a dominant spectral-temporal mode, a central resource for continuous-variable quantum computation. In the high parametric gain regime, several effects, including self- and cross-phase modulation as well as time-ordering corrections, become significant and can degrade source performance.

arxiv-2512-23631.title: BOAD: Discovering Hierarchical Software Engineering Agents via Bandit Optimization
arxiv-2512-23631.creator: Iris Xu, Guangtao Zeng, Zexue He, Charles Jin, Aldo Pareja, Dan Gutfreund, Chuang Gan, Zhang-Wei Hong
arxiv-2512-23631.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong reasoning and coding capabilities, yet they struggle to generalize to real-world software engineering (SWE) problems that are long-horizon and out-of-distribution. Existing systems often rely on a single agent to handle the entire workflow—interpreting issues, navigating large codebases, and implementing fixes—within one reasoning chain.

europmc-pmc6708158.creator: Zhang Q, Vallerga CL, Walker RM, Lin T, Henders AK, Montgomery GW, He J, Fan D, Fowdar J, Kennedy M, Pitcher T, Pearson J, Halliday G, Kwok JB, Hickie I, Lewis S, Anderson T, Silburn PA, Mellick GD, Harris SE, Redmond P, Murray AD, Porteous DJ, Haley CS, Evans KL, McIntosh AM, Yang J, Gratten J, Marioni RE, Wray NR, Deary IJ, McRae AF, Visscher PM.
europmc-pmc6708158.description: Background DNA methylation changes with age. Chronological age predictors built from DNA methylation are termed 'epigenetic clocks'. The deviation of predicted age from the actual age ('age acceleration residual', AAR) has been reported to be associated with death. However, it i

plos-pone-0003004.title: The Correction of Eye Blink Artefacts in the EEG: A Comparison of Two Prominent Methods
plos-pone-0003004.creator: Sven Hoffmann, Michael Falkenstein
plos-pone-0003004.description: PLOS ONE research article. The study investigated the residual impact of eyeblinks on the electroencephalogram (EEG) after application of different correction procedures, namely a regression method (eye movement correction procedure, EMCP) and a component based method (Independent Component Analysis, ICA).

plos-pone-0348611.title: CLIN-LLM: A safety-constrained hybrid framework for clinical diagnosis and treatment generation
plos-pone-0348611.creator: Md Mehedi Hasan, Md Abir Hossain, Farman Hossain Sayem, Bikash Kumar Paul, Ziaur Rahman, Mohammad Shorif Uddin, Rafid Mostafiz
plos-pone-0348611.description: CLIN-LLM: A safety-constrained hybrid framework for clinical diagnosis and treatment generation

pmc-10565872.title: Virtual performance measure in osteoarthritis: An innovative transformation of patient care
pmc-10565872.creator: Helen Razmjou, Suzanne Denis, Susan Robarts, James Falconer, Mark Anunciacion, Andrea Nunn, Amy Wainwright, Patricia Dickson, Roxana Najafi, John Murnaghan
pmc-10565872.description: ObjectivesThe purpose of this study was to develop and establish reliability and validity of a virtual performance measure (VPM) score that encompassed 10 videos in patients with osteoarthritis of the knee joint. Patients’ experience and satisfaction were documented.DesignForty videos were chosen for 10 functional tasks, with four videos showing increasing difficulty for each task.

pmc-10605952.title: Efficacy of photodynamic therapy in the treatment of oral candidiasis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-10605952.creator: Qiaoyu Hu, Ting Li, Jiadi Yang, Yanhui Peng, Qing Liu, Na Liu
pmc-10605952.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ObjectiveTo evaluate the clinical efficacy of photodynamic therapy (PDT) as an adjunct or alternative to traditional antifungal drugs in the treatment of oral candidiasis, and to provide evidence-based medical evidence for its use in the treatment of oral candidiasis.MethodsComputer combined with manual retrieval of China Academic Journals Full-text Database (CNKI), China Biomedical Literature Database (CBM), Chinese Science and Technology Journal Database (VIP), Wanfang Database, PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Embase, Scopus retrieval for articles published before January 2023, basic information and

pmc-11395128.title: Treatment of Chronic Haemophilic Synovitis with PRP: Clinical and In Vitro Studies
pmc-11395128.creator: Horacio Caviglia, María Eulalia Landro, Paula Oneto, Guillermo Cambiaggi, Gustavo Galatro, Micaela Berni, Laura Caliogna, Eugenio Antonio Carrera Silva, Gianluigi Pasta, Isabella Russo
pmc-11395128.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Intra-articular blood, iron and hemosiderin, hydroxyl radical cytokines, and neo-angiogenesis cause synovial inflammation, which leads to cartilage and joint damage. Platelet-rich plasma (PRP) inhibits most of the mediators that produce and maintain synovitis. We compile here our work showing the clinical effectiveness of intra-articular PRP injections and their potential role in stopping articular cartilage damage due to bleeding and its possible repair. A total of 116 joints, including knees (63%), elbows (19.8%), and ankles (17.2%), were treated with intra-articular injections of PRP.

pmc-11522421.title: Late-life psychiatric factors and life satisfaction are associated with cognitive errors: evidence from an experimental module of a large-scale survey in India
pmc-11522421.creator: C. V. Irshad, P. Padma Sri Lekha, E. P. Abdul Azeez, T. Muhammed
pmc-11522421.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Older adults are at risk of committing cognitive and decision-making errors due to the decline in cognitive functions. However, the understanding of the determining factors of cognitive errors among ageing adults is limited. In this study, we explored the role of various psychiatric factors, life satisfaction, and other socioeconomic, health and behavioural risk factors of committing cognitive errors among middle-aged and older adults in India.

pmc-11538358.title: Scalable deep learning artificial intelligence histopathology slide analysis and validation
pmc-11538358.creator: Colin Greeley, Lawrence Holder, Eric E. Nilsson, Michael K. Skinner
pmc-11538358.description: Deep learning involves an artificial intelligence (AI) approach and has been shown to provide superior performance for automating image recognition tasks, as well as exceeding human capabilities in both time and accuracy. Histopathology diagnostics is one of the more popular challenges at the intersection of artificial intelligence, computer vision, and medicine.

pmc-12429002.title: Theoretical Methods for Assessing the Density of Protein Nanodroplets
pmc-12429002.creator: Midhun Mohan Anila, Michał Wojciechowski, Mateusz Chwastyk, Bartosz Różycki
pmc-12429002.description: Many intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) are known to undergo liquid–liquid phase separation (LLPS), which is a physical process that drives the formation of biomolecular condensates and membraneless organelles in biological cells. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations provide valuable tools to explore both the molecular mechanisms of LLPS and the physical properties of biomolecular condensates.

pmc-12589119.title: The long non-coding RNA CRNDE stabilises SIRT1 protein and influences Hedgehog signalling in multiple myeloma
pmc-12589119.creator: Simone Zocchi, Pauline Trichet, Paloma Guernalec, Manal Agdada, Ana Alonso Bartolomé, Vincent Ogor, Caroline Choisy, Carine Vias, Xavier Sabaté-Cadenas, Jean-Christophe Bories, Michele Goodhardt, Alena Shkumatava, David Garrick
pmc-12589119.description: Multiple myeloma (MM) is a malignancy of immunoglobulin-secreting plasma cells that represents 10% of all hematological cancers and remains essentially incurable, despite recent advances. Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) are an important class of regulatory molecules that have been strongly implicated in the aetiology of MM.

pmc-13041089.title: Transcriptome sequencing and weighted correlation network analysis reveal the molecular mechanism of growth variation in highly resistant transgenic double Bt poplar
pmc-13041089.creator: Ziyan He, Huan Zhang, Lingyun Liu, Yang Liu, Zihui Liu, Jinmao Wang, Yachao Ren, Minsheng Yang
pmc-13041089.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The Bt gene is widely used in insect-resistant transgenic plants, but its integration (especially dual Bt genes) may cause unintended growth effects. To explore the molecular mechanism of Bt genes regulating the growth of recipient plants, we used transgenic single Bt gene poplar 741, transgenic double Bt gene poplar 741 obtained through secondary transformation, and wild-type (741) as research subjects, combined with physiological determination and transcriptome sequencing.

pmc-13084006.title: Experiences of Patients With Chronic Kidney Disease Undergoing Hemodialysis: A Qualitative Study in Bangladesh
pmc-13084006.creator: Muhammed Arshad Ul Azim, Md Enamul Kabir, Md Obaidul Haque, Md Afzalul Bashar, Zannatul Ferdous, Banga Kamal Basu, Moyeenuddin Amin, Asma Begum, Kazi Maria Haque Semme, Syed Abdullah Jami, Nazim Uzzaman, GM Monsur Habib
pmc-13084006.description: Background:Despite the increasing burden of chronic kidney disease (CKD) and its associated challenges, there is limited understanding of the lived experiences, awareness, and treatment perspectives of patients in Bangladesh.Objective:We aimed to explore the experiences of patients with CKD undergoing maintenance hemodialysis in Bangladesh, identifying key challenges and areas for improvement.Design:Descriptive qualitative study.Setting:Khulna, Bangladesh.Participants:Individuals with CKD undergoing maintenance hemodialysis.

pmc-13085694.title: Technical efficiency of sub-district level hospitals in Bangladesh: a comparative frontier analysis
pmc-13085694.creator: Md Zahid Hasan, Edward JD Webb, Silviya Nikolova, Khadija Islam Tisha, Zahidul Quayyum, Tim Ensor
pmc-13085694.description: BackgroundIn Bangladesh, sub-district hospitals (SDHs) are the first referral point for inpatient primary healthcare (PHC) services of the public providers in both rural and municipal corporation areas. These facilities also provide both outpatient and emergency healthcare services to the population at a minimum user fee.

pmc-13188580.title: The mutational burden in os odontoideum patients
pmc-13188580.creator: Yinglun Tian, Guodong Gao, Dongwei Fan, Shilin Xue, Qiyue Gao, Cheng Zhang, Nanfang Xu, Shenglin Wang
pmc-13188580.description: BackgroundOs odontoideum(OO) is a rare bone malformation at the craniovertebral junction, the presence of which can lead to potential instability of atlantoaxial joints. The cause, prevalence and treatment of OO are still controversial. There are two main theories regarding the pathogenesis of OO: congenital factors and traumatic factors.

pmc-13267685.title: In vivo quantification of mitochondrial O2 affinity in human skeletal muscle using 1H‐magnetic resonance spectroscopy of deoxy‐myoglobin
pmc-13267685.creator: Muhammet Enes Erol, Alexs A. Matias, Corinna F. Serviente, Stephen T. Decker, Rajakumar Nagarajan, Saadallah Ramadan, Yann Le Fur, Song‐Young Park, Gwenael Layec
pmc-13267685.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Mitochondrial oxygen (O2) affinity is a fundamental determinant of oxidative phosphorylation capacity, which has yet to be directly measured in human skeletal muscle in vivo. To determine the apparent mitochondrial O2 affinity (i.e. P 50) of the skeletal muscle, we used proton‐magnetic resonance spectroscopy (1H‐MRS) of deoxymyoglobin (dMb) during a circulatory occlusion of the lower limb to simultaneously quantify intracellular partial pressure of O2 (i PO2) and resting tissue‐specific O2 consumption (V˙O2) in the gastrocnemius muscle of sedentary young adults.

pmc-13285649.title: hSpindly dynamics modulate spindle assembly checkpoint signaling, promoting resistance to mitotic inhibitors
pmc-13285649.creator: Mar Mora-Santos, Joaquín Herrero-Ruiz, Dirk Fennema-Galparsoro, Alejandro Belmonte-Fernández, Nuria Ferrandiz, Francisco Romero

pmc-13388955.title: The essential chaperone DNAJC17 activates HSP70 to coordinate RNA splicing and G2-M progression
pmc-13388955.creator: David V. Allegakoen, Pushpendra K. Sahu, Kristen Kwong, Jacqueline Morales, Trever G. Bivona, Amit J. Sabnis
pmc-13388955.description: Molecular chaperones including the heat-shock protein 70-kilodalton (HSP70) family and the J-domain containing protein (JDP) co-chaperones maintain homeostatic balance in eukaryotic cells through regulation of the proteome. The expansive JDP family helps direct specific HSP70 functions, yet loss of single JDP-encoding genes is widely tolerated by mammalian cells, suggesting a high degree of redundancy.

pmc-13432652.title: Airway Intervention in Paediatric Angioedema: A National Analysis of Clinical Predictors and Outcomes
pmc-13432652.creator: Saharsh Talwar, Aryan Mahajan, Gaurav N Pathak, Babar K Rao, Rachel Kaye
pmc-13432652.description: ObjectiveTo characterize paediatric hospitalizations for angioedema and identify the prevalence and outcomes of airway interventions using a large national database.MethodsWe performed a cross‐sectional analysis of the Kids' Inpatient Database (2003–2019), including paediatric patients (0–20 years) hospitalized with angioedema identified by ICD‐9/10 codes. Outcomes included hospital length of stay (LOS), total charges, and in‐hospital mortality.

pmc-13454384.title: CD4 Count and Clinical Outcomes of Mpox in People Living With HIV: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
pmc-13454384.creator: Kesaobaka Batisani, David Chisompola, Tolulope Joseph Ogunniyi, Godsave Binlak Wazhi, Ronald Simusokwe, Misheck Chileshe, Dike Ujunwa Precious, Mahlale Maenetja, Rosemary Mosweu, Hezron Lubemba, Stephen Ebuka Ukaobasi, Nandi Mwangilwa, Lungowe Mulope, Roseline Dzekem Dine, Charles Saleji, Eustarckio
pmc-13454384.description: BackgroundHIV causes immunosuppression by targeting CD4+ T lymphocytes, which may influence susceptibility and clinical outcomes of coinfections such as the Mpox virus (MPXV). Despite conflicting evidence, understanding the relationship between CD4 counts and MPXV severity in people living with HIV (PLWH) remains critical. This study systematically reviews and meta‐analyzes available evidence to elucidate this association.

pmc-13485508.title: Acupuncture for ovulation induction in polycystic ovary syndrome: study protocol for a multicenter, randomized, sham-controlled trial
pmc-13485508.creator: Jiashan Li, Zhaohui Li, Lixia Pei, Jingqing Sun, Jian Wang, Qun Lu, Li Yang, Tian Hang, Lingyu Qi, Quanying Zhang, Dongxue An, Chenchen Su, Ge Lu, Xinyu Yan, Yigong Fang, Huanfang Xu
pmc-13485508.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionPolycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a common endocrine disorder affecting up to 15% of reproductive-aged women, and is characterized by chronic anovulation that leads to irregular menstrual cycles, infertility, and long-term health risks. While acupuncture has been used for ovulation induction in PCOS, existing evidence remains inconclusive due to methodological limitations and clinical heterogeneity of enrolled populations, which have been largely overlooked.

pmc-13577397.title: Assessment of vaccination competency among health workers in health facilities in East Wollega, Oromia, Western Ethiopia: An observational study
pmc-13577397.creator: Adugna Olani, Gedefa Bayisa, Merga Chala, Lami Gurmessa, Jiregna Fayera, David J. Diemert, David Diemert, David Diemert
pmc-13577397.description: BackgroundVaccination competency is a critical determinant of immunization quality and safety. However, limited evidence exists on the practical skills of frontline providers in Ethiopia.MethodsA facility-based observational study assessing vaccination competency among health care providers involved in routine childhood immunization.ResultsA total of 34 providers were observed while administering 10 vaccine doses each, resulting in 340 observed vaccination encounters.

pmc-13614496.title: The Interplay of CD8+ TILs and Microvascular Density: A Novel Prognostic Indicator in Colorectal Adenocarcinoma
pmc-13614496.creator: Heru Fajar Trianto, Gondo Mastutik, Desak Gede Agung Suprabawati, Mahyarudin Mahyarudin
pmc-13614496.description: Objective:The purpose of this study was to investigate the association of CD8⁺ tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (CD8⁺ TILs), microvascular density (MVD), and vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) with the TNM (Tumor-Node-Metastasis) stage, as well as to analyze their interrelationships in colorectal adenocarcinoma.Methods:This cross-sectional study involved 50 FFPE samples of colorectal adenocarcinoma from the Laboratory of Anatomical Pathology at Dr. Soedarso Hospital.

pmc-13675123.title: Maternal deaths and severe maternal morbidity in the Nordic countries—Time to build collaborative routine surveillance and shared learning to improve healthcare
pmc-13675123.creator: Hilde Marie Engjom, Outi Äyräs, Anna Aabakke, Eva Jonasdottir, Teresia Svanvik, Lill Nyfløt
pmc-13675123.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ans and epidemiologists in the five Nordic countries: Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, and Sweden and aim to describe causes of maternal deaths and severe morbidity and facilitate joint learning to improve clinical obstetric care in the Nordic countries. The Nordic collaborations participate jointly in the International Network of Obstetric Survey Systems (INOSS) with other countries in Europe, North America, Africa, and Asia.
